pack_facts.text: GLP-1 NAION Vision Loss Lawsuit - July 2026 Case Update: NAION (non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy) is a sudden loss of vision caused by reduced blood flow to the optic nerve. It is the second most common optic neuropathy and often results in permanent blindness in one or both eyes.
